concepts.suggested_change: Coordinator reduction: create or update the shared platform-specific subscription concept with this guide's lifecycle facts: subscription-rate-card price changes propagate to inheriting contracts at the next billing period, except a contract overwrite retains its assigned price; a sub-cycle trial uses two consecutive subscriptions and a $0 override on the first, while a full-cycle trial uses one time-bounded $0 override before next-period list pricing; add-ons use `add_subscription` and the guide says the relevant rate's `entitlement` is `true`; `transition.type=renewal` is recommended for upgrades and downgrades, with proration only for upgrade motions and next-period effect for downgrades; cancellation can end a contract or subscription, most cancellations should end the contract, later restarts should create a new contract, hybrid cancellation also ends recurring credit separately, and finalized service periods prevent contract-end-date changes from extending an in-advance subscription. Preserve the unresolved create-contract-label/edit-contract-link inconsistency and qualify `entitlement` as this guide's wording because existing rate-card context says `entitled`. Add [[source-metronome-guides-pricing-packaging-subscription-manage-subscription-lifecycle]] under Sources for retained facts.
